name: Coteaux du Layon

known.via: English Wikipedia "Coteaux du Layon AOC" (redirects to "Coteaux du Layon")

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
Indication Géographique Protégée, the tier below AOC. It replaced vin de pays in 2009.
France's simplest category, in use since 2010. It replaced vin de table.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

notes: Coteaux du Layon is a sweet Chenin Blanc white that is never dry, though the sweetness varies.
Basic wines are semi-sweet, and some producers make very sweet wines with intense botrytis character.
Next to sweet Vouvray, the wines tend to be fuller bodied, often sweeter and slightly lower in acidity.
Chenin Blanc gives them high acidity when young and the ability to age well.

blurb.text: A Loire Valley appellation for sweet white wine, made from Chenin along the River Layon in Anjou. Six villages, such as Beaulieu-sur-Layon and Saint-Aubin-de-Luigné, may add their name to the label.
